as_told.title: XF-131 design used in the X-Files pilot

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels that a real craft design, which he calls the XF-131, appeared in the very first episode of The X-Files in 1993, and that the episode was said to be based on true stories from a man named John Duza. He adds that a man named Bill McDonald was contracted to put the design into the episode, and he mentions Chris Carter in connection with it, though he gives no source for any of this. If true, a design tied to secret aircraft would have reached television hidden in plain sight.
